goal: Catch silent merge breakages across open pull requests by regularly testing them against current master
Saves contributors and maintainers from manually retesting or rebasing cleanly merging PRs
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Support for running the check in repository CI instead of external bots (maflcko)
Approach approval finding this to be the right direction (fjahr)
Unanswered question on handling multiple simultaneous labels (Sammie05)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it reduces friction by catching build failures when master changes beneath clean git merges
It improves CI tooling without addressing critical release integrity or platform breakages

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because periodic test runs catch semantic regressions across candidate PRs before merge
It orchestrates existing test suites rather than improving test harnesses or coverage directly
